+  void DMMotor::UpdateState()
+  {
+    if (!protocol_->HasPositionFeedback()) {return;}
+    double raw_position = protocol_->GetPosition(id_);
+    double raw_velocity = protocol_->GetVelocity(id_);
+    double raw_torque = protocol_->GetCurrent(id_);
+    temperature_ = protocol_->GetTemperature(id_);
+
+    if (coord_system_ == CoordinateSystem::LeftHand) {
+      raw_position = -raw_position;
+      raw_velocity = -raw_velocity;
+      raw_torque = -raw_torque;
+    }
+
+    // The motor protocol reports a periodic absolute angle.  Keep the joint
+    // angle continuous across +/-pi instead of exposing 2*pi jumps to the
+    // joint-limit checks, gravity model, and position controller.
+    constexpr double TWO_PI = 2.0 * M_PI;
+    if (!is_received_) {
+      position_ = std::remainder(raw_position, TWO_PI);
+    } else {
+      position_ += std::remainder(raw_position - position_, TWO_PI);
+    }
+    velocity_ = raw_velocity;
+    torque_ = raw_torque;
+
+    is_received_ = true;
+  }
+
+  void DMMotor::UpdateCommand(const dummy_interface::msg::MotorControl & cmd)
+  {
+    if (not is_received_) {return;}
+
+    if (id_ >= cmd.p.size() or id_ >= cmd.d.size() or id_ >= cmd.current.size() ||
+      id_ >= cmd.position.size() || id_ >= cmd.velocity.size())
+    {
+      return;
+    }
+    for (double value : {cmd.p[id_], cmd.d[id_], cmd.current[id_],
+        cmd.position[id_], cmd.velocity[id_]})
+    {
+      if (!std::isfinite(value)) {return;}
+    }
+    if (cmd.p[id_] < 0.0 || cmd.d[id_] < 0.0) {return;}
+
+    protocol_->SetKp(id_, cmd.p[id_]);
+    protocol_->SetKd(id_, cmd.d[id_]);
+    SetCurrent(cmd.current[id_]);
+
+    double desired_pos = cmd.position[id_];
+
+    // set kp kd to default value and set position to limit if position is out of range
+    if (position_ < lower_limit_ + 0.05 or position_ > upper_limit_ - 0.05) {
+      if (cmd.p[id_] == 0) {
+        protocol_->SetKp(id_, p_gain_default_);
+        protocol_->SetKd(id_, d_gain_default_);
+        desired_pos = std::clamp(position_, lower_limit_ + 0.05, upper_limit_ - 0.05);
+      }
+      // if position is in range, set desired position to position
+      else if (cmd.position[id_] >= lower_limit_ + 0.05 and cmd.position[id_] <=
+        upper_limit_ - 0.05)
+      {
+        desired_pos = cmd.position[id_];
+      } else {
+        desired_pos = std::clamp(position_, lower_limit_ + 0.05, upper_limit_ - 0.05);
+      }
+    }
+
+    // set position to current position if limit is reached
+    SetPositionAndVelocity(desired_pos, cmd.velocity[id_]);
+
+  }
+

+  void ProtocolV1::Feed(const uint8_t byte)
+  {
+    uint8_t * raw = reinterpret_cast < uint8_t * > (&recv_);
+    if (recv_step_ < 2) {
+      if (byte == raw[recv_step_]) {
+        recv_step_++;
+      } else {
+        recv_step_ = 0;
+      }
+    } else if (recv_step_ == 2) {
+      recv_.cmd = byte;
+      recv_step_++;
+    } else if (recv_step_ == 3) {
+      recv_.dataLen = byte;
+      recv_step_++;
+    } else if (recv_step_ < 4 + recv_.dataLen) {
+      recv_.dataBuf[recv_step_ - 4] = byte;
+      recv_step_++;
+    } else if (recv_step_ == 4 + recv_.dataLen) {
+      recv_.sumCheck = byte;
+      recv_step_++;
+    } else if (recv_step_ == 5 + recv_.dataLen) {
+      recv_.addCheck = byte;
+      DecodeFrame();
+      recv_step_ = 0;
+    }

+
+  void ProtocolV1::Check(LinkFrame & f)
+  {
+    uint8_t sum = 0, add = 0;
+    uint8_t * p = reinterpret_cast < uint8_t * > (&f);
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < 4 + f.dataLen; i++) {
+      sum += p[i];
+      add += sum;
+    }
+    f.sumCheck = sum;
+    f.addCheck = add;
+  }
+
+  void ProtocolV1::DecodeFrame()
+  {
+
+    uint8_t sum = recv_.sumCheck;
+    uint8_t add = recv_.addCheck;
+    Check(recv_);
+
+    if (sum != recv_.sumCheck || add != recv_.addCheck) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const bool floats = recv_.cmd >= 0x20 && recv_.cmd <= 0x23;
+    if ((floats && recv_.dataLen != 28) ||
+      (recv_.cmd == 0x24 && recv_.dataLen != 14) ||
+      (recv_.cmd == 0x01 && recv_.dataLen != 1)) {return;}
+    if (floats) {
+      for (size_t i = 0; i < active_motor_count_; ++i) {
+        float value;
+        std::memcpy(&value, recv_.dataBuf + i * sizeof(float), sizeof(float));
+        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
+          if (recv_.cmd <= 0x22) {feedback_stamp_[recv_.cmd - 0x20] = {}}
+          return;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    switch (recv_.cmd) {
+      case 0x01: DecodeHeartbeat(); return;
+      case 0x20: DecodePosition(); break;
+      case 0x21: DecodeVelocity(); break;
+      case 0x22: DecodeCurrent(); break;
+      case 0x23: DecodeVoltage(); break;
+      case 0x24: DecodeTemperature(); break;
+      default:
+        // Board also emits 0x25 (28 B, ~2 Hz) whose meaning is undocumented.
+        // Counted rather than interpreted so firmware changes stay visible.
+        unhandled_frame_count_++;
+        last_unhandled_cmd_ = recv_.cmd;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (recv_.cmd >= 0x20 && recv_.cmd <= 0x22) {
+      const size_t index = recv_.cmd - 0x20;
+      ++feedback_count_[index];
+      feedback_stamp_[index] = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
+    }
+    Notify();
+  }
+
+  void ProtocolV1::DecodeHeartbeat()
+  {
+    heartbeat_count_++;
+    heartbeat_seen_ = true;
+    last_heartbeat_ = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
+  }
+
+  double ProtocolV1::GetSecondsSinceHeartbeat() const
+  {
+    if (not heartbeat_seen_) {
+      return std::numeric_limits < double > ::infinity();
+    }
+    const auto age = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - last_heartbeat_;
+    return std::chrono::duration < double > (age).count();
+  }

+  template < typename T >
+  static void DecodeArray(const uint8_t * buf, std::vector < double > & out, int n)
+  {
+    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+      T v;
+      std::memcpy(&v, buf + i * sizeof(T), sizeof(T));
+      out[i] = static_cast < double > (v);
+    }
+  }

+  void ProtocolV1::MakeFrame(
+    uint8_t cmd, const void * data,
+    size_t len, std::vector < uint8_t > & out)
+  {
+    out.resize(4 + len + 2);
+
+    out[0] = 0xFE;
+    out[1] = 0xAA; // send addr
+    out[2] = cmd;
+    out[3] = len;
+

+    }

+    uint8_t sum = 0, add = 0;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < 4 + len; i++) {
+      sum += out[i];
+      add += sum;
+    }
+
+    out[4 + len] = sum;
+    out[5 + len] = add;
+  }

+  std::string RobotHealthAggregator::ModuleFromTopic(const std::string & topic)
+  {
+    auto pos = topic.find_last_of('/');
+    if (pos == std::string::npos || pos + 1 >= topic.size()) {

+  std::string RobotHealthAggregator::ExtractJsonString(
+    const std::string & data,
+    const std::string & key,
+    const std::string & fallback)
+  {
+    std::string token = "\"" + key + "\"";
+    auto key_pos = data.find(token);
+    if (key_pos == std::string::npos) {
+      return fallback;
+    }
+    auto colon_pos = data.find(':', key_pos + token.size());
+    if (colon_pos == std::string::npos) {
+      return fallback;
+    }
+    auto first_quote = data.find('"', colon_pos + 1);
+    if (first_quote == std::string::npos) {
+      return fallback;
+    }
+    auto second_quote = data.find('"', first_quote + 1);
+    if (second_quote == std::string::npos) {
+      return fallback;
+    }
+    return data.substr(first_quote + 1, second_quote - first_quote - 1);
+  }
+
+  std::string RobotHealthAggregator::ExtractJsonObject(
+    const std::string & data,
+    const std::string & key)
+  {
+    std::string token = "\"" + key + "\"";
+    auto key_pos = data.find(token);
+    if (key_pos == std::string::npos) {
+      return "";
+    }
+    auto colon_pos = data.find(':', key_pos + token.size());
+    if (colon_pos == std::string::npos) {
+      return "";
+    }
+    auto object_start = data.find('{', colon_pos + 1);
+    if (object_start == std::string::npos) {
+      return "";
+    }
+
+    int depth = 0;
+    bool in_string = false;
+    bool escaped = false;
+    for (size_t i = object_start; i < data.size(); ++i) {
+      char c = data[i];
+      if (escaped) {
+        escaped = false;
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (c == '\\') {
+        escaped = true;
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (c == '"') {
+        in_string = !in_string;
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (in_string) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (c == '{') {
+        ++depth;
+      } else if (c == '}') {
+        --depth;
+        if (depth == 0) {
+          return data.substr(object_start, i - object_start + 1);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  std::string RobotHealthAggregator::EscapeJson(const std::string & value)
+  {
+    std::string out;
+    out.reserve(value.size());
+    for (char c : value) {
+      if (c == '"' || c == '\\') {
+        out.push_back('\\');
+      }
+      out.push_back(c);
+    }
+    return out;
+  }
+
+  int RobotHealthAggregator::StatusRank(const std::string & status)
+  {
+    if (status == "ERROR" || status == "STALE" || status == "NO_DATA") {
+      return 3;
+    }
+    if (status == "WARN") {
+      return 2;
+    }
+    return 1;
+  }

+      return "WARN";
+    }

+  void RobotHealthAggregator::PublishHealth()
+  {
+    auto current_time = now();
+    int overall_rank = 1;
+    std::ostringstream modules;
+    bool first = true;
+
+    for (auto & item : states_) {
+      auto & module = item.first;
+      auto & state = item.second;
+      std::string status = state.status;
+      std::string code = state.code;
+      std::string message = state.message;
+      std::string metrics = ExtractJsonObject(state.raw, "metrics");
+      double age = -1.0;
+
+      if (state.received) {
+        age = (current_time - state.last_seen).seconds();
+        if (age > timeout_sec_) {
+          status = "STALE";
+          code = "HEALTH_TIMEOUT";
+          message = "health timeout";
+        }
+      }
+
+      overall_rank = std::max(overall_rank, StatusRank(status));
+
+      if (!first) {
+        modules << ",";
+      }
+      first = false;
+      modules << "\"" << EscapeJson(module) << "\":{";
+      modules << "\"topic\":\"" << EscapeJson(state.topic) << "\",";
+      modules << "\"status\":\"" << EscapeJson(status) << "\",";
+      modules << "\"code\":\"" << EscapeJson(code) << "\",";
+      modules << "\"message\":\"" << EscapeJson(message) << "\",";
+      modules << "\"age\":" << age << ",";
+      modules << "\"timeout\":" << timeout_sec_;
+      if (!metrics.empty() && status != "STALE") {
+        modules << ",\"metrics\":" << metrics;
+      }
+      modules << "}";
+    }
+
+    std_msgs::msg::String msg;
+    std::ostringstream payload;
+    payload << "{";
+    payload << "\"stamp\":" << current_time.seconds() << ",";
+    payload << "\"overall\":\"" << RankStatus(overall_rank) << "\",";
+    payload << "\"modules\":{" << modules.str() << "}";
+    payload << "}";
+    msg.data = payload.str();
+    pub_health_->publish(msg);
+  }

+  void StudentArmNode::SetupHandover()
+  {
+    if (!familiarization_mode_ || !speed_safety_) {
+      throw std::invalid_argument("handover requires familiarization safety");
+    }
+    GetParam < bool > ("manual_push_test", false);
+    quiet_duration_ = GetParam < double > ("no_touch_duration_sec", 0.);
+    quiet_tolerance_ = GetParam < double > ("no_touch_position_tolerance", 0.);
+    quiet_speed_ = GetParam < double > ("no_touch_speed_limit", 0.);
+    handover_joint_margin_ = GetParam < double > ("joint_limit_margin", 0.);

+    initial_hold_command_.d = GetParam < std::vector < double >> ("initial_hold_d", {});

+    seed_expected_q_ = GetParam < std::vector < double >> ("initial_hold_expected_q", {});
+    initial_hold_position_tolerance_ = GetParam < double > ("initial_hold_position_tolerance", .03);
+    if (!std::isfinite(initial_hold_position_tolerance_) ||
+      initial_hold_position_tolerance_ <= 0. ||
+      initial_hold_position_tolerance_ > .03)
+    {
+      throw std::invalid_argument("invalid startup position tolerance");
+    }
+    if (GetParam < bool > ("initial_hold_is_support_estimate", false)) {
+      RCLCPP_WARN(
+        get_logger(),
+        "SUPPORTED_STARTUP: first HOLD uses measured-effort estimate, not old-command readback; external support required");
+    }
+    has_seed_ = !initial_hold_command_.position.empty();
+    if (has_seed_ && seed_expected_q_.size() != 6) {
+      throw std::invalid_argument("hold seed needs expected six-axis feedback");
+    }
+
+    prepare_service_ = create_service < std_srvs::srv::Trigger > ("~/prepare_guidance",
+      [this](const std::shared_ptr < std_srvs::srv::Trigger::Request >,
+      std::shared_ptr < std_srvs::srv::Trigger::Response > res) {
+      if (read_only_ || feedback_fault_latched_ || !FeedbackSafe() || !operator_hold_ ||
+      !motor_command_sent_ || awaiting_handover_)
+      {
+        res->message = "healthy authoritative hold required"; return;
+      }
+      for (double v:last_known_velocity_) {
+        if (std::abs(v) > .15) {
+          res->message = "arm must be stationary"; return;
+        }
+      }
+      expected_first_command_ = last_applied_command_;
+      awaiting_handover_ = true; prepare_stamp_ = SteadySeconds();
+      trial_counted_ = false; quiet_since_ = -1.; manual_push_active_ = false;
+      res->success = true; res->message = CommandJson(expected_first_command_);
+      RCLCPP_INFO(
+        get_logger(), "HANDOVER_START: authoritative hold snapshot, completed=%d",
+        completed_handovers_);
+    });
+    operator_hold_service_ = create_service < std_srvs::srv::Trigger > ("~/operator_hold",
+      [this](const std::shared_ptr < std_srvs::srv::Trigger::Request >,
+      std::shared_ptr < std_srvs::srv::Trigger::Response > res) {
+      if (read_only_ || feedback_fault_latched_ || !FeedbackSafe() || !motor_command_sent_) {
+        res->message = "cannot clear a fault or hold invalid feedback"; return;
+      }
+      auto hold = MakeHoldPositionCommand();
+      // Healthy GUIDE -> HOLD also preserves total command at the measured state.
+      for (size_t i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
+        double total = last_applied_command_.p[i] *
+        (last_applied_command_.position[i] - last_known_position_[i]) -
+        last_applied_command_.d[i] * last_known_velocity_[i] + last_applied_command_.current[i];
+        hold.position[i] = last_known_position_[i] +
+        (total - hold.current[i] + hold.d[i] * last_known_velocity_[i]) / hold.p[i];
+      }
+      if (!ValidateEffortCommand(hold)) {res->message = "hold outside command limits"; return;}
+      last_effort_command_ = hold; operator_hold_ = true; awaiting_handover_ = false;
+      manual_push_active_ = false; effort_zeroed_ = true; got_effort_command_ = true;
+      res->success = true; res->message = "operator HOLD; fault latch unchanged";
+      RCLCPP_INFO(
+        get_logger(), "HOLD: operator stop; completed no-touch handovers=%d",
+        completed_handovers_);
+    });
+    manual_service_ = create_service < std_srvs::srv::Trigger > ("~/begin_manual_push",
+      [this](const std::shared_ptr < std_srvs::srv::Trigger::Request >,
+      std::shared_ptr < std_srvs::srv::Trigger::Response > res) {
+      if (read_only_ || !get_parameter("manual_push_test").as_bool() || feedback_fault_latched_ ||
+      !FeedbackSafe() || !last_output_guide_ || operator_hold_ || !trial_counted_ ||
+      completed_handovers_ < required_handovers_ || quiet_since_ < 0. ||
+      SteadySeconds() - quiet_since_ < quiet_duration_)
+      {
+        res->message =
+        "manual push requires explicit flag, GUIDE and three successful no-touch handovers";
+        return;
+      }
+      manual_push_active_ = true; res->success = true;
+      res->message = "MANUAL_PUSH enabled explicitly";
+      RCLCPP_INFO(get_logger(), "MANUAL_PUSH: explicit operator request accepted");
+    });
+  }

+  void StudentArmNode::UpdateNoTouchGate()
+  {
+    if (!bumpless_handover_ || manual_push_active_) {return;}
+    bool quiet = last_output_guide_ && !feedback_fault_latched_ && FeedbackSafe();
+    for (double v:last_known_velocity_) {
+      quiet = quiet && std::abs(v) <= quiet_speed_;
+    }
+    if (!quiet) {quiet_since_ = -1.; return;}
+    if (quiet_since_ >= 0.) {
+      for (size_t i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
+        if (std::abs(last_known_position_[i] - quiet_q_[i]) > quiet_tolerance_) {
+          quiet_since_ = -1.;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    if (quiet_since_ < 0.) {quiet_since_ = SteadySeconds(); quiet_q_ = last_known_position_;}
+    if (!trial_counted_ && SteadySeconds() - quiet_since_ >= quiet_duration_) {
+      ++completed_handovers_; trial_counted_ = true;
+      RCLCPP_INFO(get_logger(), "NO_TOUCH_PASS: completed handovers=%d", completed_handovers_);
+    }
+  }

+  void StudentArmNode::PublishAppliedCommand(const dummy_interface::msg::MotorControl & cmd)
+  {
+    if (!bumpless_handover_) {return;}

+          (last_applied_command_.position[i] - last_known_position_[i]) -
+          last_applied_command_.d[i] * last_known_velocity_[i] + last_applied_command_.current[i]);
+      }
+    }

+      out,

+    out << ",\"delta_total_command_from_previous_cycle\":";JsonArray(out, step);

+      (manual_push_active_ ? "true" : "false") << '}';
+    std_msgs::msg::String msg;msg.data = out.str();pub_support_->publish(msg);
